criteria.K1: Accurate relevant project rules and distinct focus destinations.
criteria.K2: Sequential keyboard traversal and Enter evidence for Back; click or programmatic focus alone is insufficient.
criteria.K3: Unanswered state and enforced activation, network and origin boundaries.
criteria.K4: Evidence or explicit uncertainty; never mislabel a protocol fixture result as a website defect.
criteria.K5: Relevant checker command and acceptance checks for planning/review; proposed and executed commands remain distinct.
criteria.K6: Any finding on the corrected comparator is supported; an empty review is permitted, not required.
criteria.K7: The documentation-only plan preserves valid obligations and does not invent an application change.
criteria.K8: Scoped decision supported by actual observations.
